limitations: Silhouette and ornament remain a procedural interpretation and do not reproduce the supplied design sheet at AAA fidelity.
High-poly micro relief includes shader bump; it is not all sculpted mesh detail.
UV density and overlaps are sampled; inspect at target mip levels before approval.
Fit uses an ellipsoid proxy, not the actual ShadowknightUE_SK section and gorget; animation and donning clearance unverified.
The export is static and is not yet bound to the required head/neck_01 skeleton.
Unreal Engine 5.3 import, material HelmW visibility, and section-3 replacement have not been tested.
No claim of final production readiness or AAA artistic quality.
Interior render is dark; inspect the lining directly in Blender. Brow and eye-rim surface finishing still need an artistic pass.

baking.UV_method: Blender angle-based Smart UV Project, average island scale, packed atlas
baking.Normal: Actual selected high-to-low tangent NORMAL bake, OpenGL and green-inverted DirectX
baking.AO: Actual Cycles low mesh AO bake
baking.game_textures: Use *_Baked.png plus uniform T_Helmet_Metallic.png; unsuffixed maps are source atlas / earlier revisions
baking.visual_review: Final three-quarter and underside renders inspected. Exterior materials and the open lower passage are visible; the interior lighting is insufficient for detailed lining review. Artistic fidelity and brow surface finishing remain unapproved.

additional_checks.BVH_limit: Bounding-volume candidates require exact intersection review if nonzero.

fbx_roundtrip.note: Blender FBX round-trip only; Unreal not tested.

uv_raster_audit.limit: Raster sampled evidence; does not rule out subpixel overlaps.

normal_map_sampled_audit.limit: Black-texel check detects some missed projections; it does not establish full normal-map quality.
